finding: The observed V7 Local Factor PairFit uses a pair-excluded orientation-invariant temporal PC1, while the marginal residual-unit-root bootstrap rebuilt its nuisance factor as an arithmetic mean of controls. The observed statistic and bootstrap null were therefore conditioned on different factor constructions, reintroducing YES/NO sign-coding cancellation inside inference.

counterexample.orientation_invariant_pc1: non-degenerate and invariant to independently flipping control signs
counterexample.consequence: The old bootstrap factor can collapse even when the observed PairFit factor is strong, so its marginal p-value is not calibrated for the statistic actually used by the model.

repair.bootstrap_factor: same exact pair-excluded orientation-invariant temporal PC1
repair.null: conditional marginal residual I(1); resample dependent residual increments and reconstruct the target residual level path
repair.threshold_aggression: not justified by this repair alone

regressions: bootstrap factor equals the observed orientation-invariant factor on a +,+,-,- control fixture
arithmetic control mean collapses to zero on the same fixture
marginal bootstrap p-value is invariant to independent sign recoding of nuisance controls
existing mixed composite-null and other-target-path invariance tests remain required
